source: audited final checkpoints and committed CompanyDecision records; no model calls
path_convention: All evidence paths are relative to the campaign directory; no private model reasoning is included.
measurement_notes: All monetary fields are integer cents unless explicitly a mean.
bankruptcy_day is the first recorded ending_cash_cents < 0 and is cross-checked against final status.
Cash paths are accounting diagnostics, not interim official Scores; daily histories omit paid inbound inventory required by the official Score.
action_counts count fields present in committed effective CompanyDecision records, including explicit zero values; they do not count successful model tool calls.
All 24 cases per model are retained in averages; post-bankruptcy cash remains frozen and no survivor-only filtering is used.

usage_totals and per-case usage sum the available numeric counters attached to final settled decision records, including final no-op outcomes; they exclude the discarded fresh-attempt archive receipts summarized separately in archived_fresh_usage and are not totals for every provider request ever made.

Usage can be incomplete, as represented by diagnostics.budget_usage_incomplete in source decision records; unreported usage is not reconstructed here, and stored zero counters do not certify complete provider accounting. Neither settled usage nor archived_fresh_usage, separately or added together, is claimed to be a complete provider bill.

archived_fresh_usage.scope: Recorded usage retained in the three audited discarded attempts preceding fresh decision redos; reported separately from final settled decision usage_totals.

selected_evidence.selection: 12th of 24 Astra outcomes in ascending final Score
